scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:adapter
scripts.gen:protocol: cargo run -q -p oh-my-whale-core --bin export_schema -- packages/adapter/src/generated && node scripts/generate-protocol-types.mjs
scripts.check:protocol: pnpm run gen:protocol && git diff --exit-code -- packages/adapter/src/generated
scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run check:protocol && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:contract
scripts.test:contract: pnpm run build:core && node --test tests/contract/core-adapter.test.ts tests/contract/degrade-contract.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:adapter && pnpm run typecheck:contract
